sections.html:
Homewood sits on the side of Red Mountain in southeastern Jefferson County, due south of downtown Birmingham, at about 705 feet. The city covers 8.31 square miles and is almost entirely built out, so there is no rural fringe. ZIP codes are 35209, 35219 and 35259, and the area codes are 205 and 659. Shades Creek runs through town.

Residents numbered 26,414 in 2020, living in 9,770 households, and the 2025 estimate is 28,118. Of 10,942 housing units, 10.7% stood empty. Vacancy was 2.2% for owner-occupied homes but 16.1% for rentals, so a landlord with an empty unit pays tax and insurance with no income coming in. Median age is 31.3, and 34.3 percent of households have children under 18.

Your competition is mostly other houses in the same few neighborhoods.

Homewood incorporated on December 29, 1926. Hollywood, a separate town that began as a subdivision the same year, joined on October 14, 1929, and Oak Grove followed in 1955. Many Hollywood houses are Spanish Colonial Revival with some English Tudor touches. Since 2002 the district has been on the National Register of Historic Places, with 815 acres and 412 contributing buildings.

Inside that boundary, age and style attract some buyers and put off others who want large changes. Say so early, and ask city hall whether any rules reach your lot.

With about 3,192 people per square mile, lots tend to be small and houses close to their neighbors. Buyers look at fences, drainage, parking and shared lot lines. On a sloped lot near Red Mountain or Shades Creek, an inspector will look at foundations, grading and basements, so keep receipts for any past repair.

  • Get a copy of the plat for your subdivision from the probate office.
  • Note any drainage problem near the creek or on a slope.
  • Be ready to say which fences and lot lines belong to you.

Homewood runs its own school system with five schools: Shades Cahaba Elementary, Edgewood Elementary, Hall-Kent Elementary, Homewood Middle and Homewood High. Samford University is also in town. Families shop by attendance zone, so a seller who can name the elementary school for the address gives buyers an easy starting point.

City government changed from mayor-council to council-manager after a vote in September 2024, effective November 2025. Procedures may be organized differently than older guidance suggests, so call city hall for current permit and code rules before you tell a buyer anything about permits.

Jefferson County deeds are filed with the Probate Court. Choose the Birmingham Division at 716 North Richard Arrington Jr. Blvd. or the Bessemer Division at 1801 3rd Avenue North; both keep hours from 8:00 a.m. to 4:00 p.m., Monday through Friday. Clerks will not search a title or write or revise a deed, so you will need a lawyer or title office for that. Public records, many viewable online, are open to anyone.

Alabama's deed tax is 50 cents per $500 of value, per Alabama Code 40-22-1. A form with the real price goes with the deed, and the clerk calculates the tax at filing.

Property is assessed at the county courthouse. October 1 is the lien date, payment is due the following October 1, and anything unpaid after December 31 is delinquent.

At closing the year's tax is typically split day by day between you and the buyer. Look up the current bill before signing a contract.

A rental can be sold with tenants in place or after they leave. Read the lease for notice terms, and ask a lawyer or title agent what rights the tenant keeps before choosing a closing date. If the unit is vacant, tax and insurance keep running every month.

sections.h2: If a mortgage or tax is still owed
sections.html:
Owing money on a Homewood house does not block a sale. The lender sends a payoff figure, the closing agent pays it from your proceeds and the lien is released when the deed changes hands. Past-due property tax is cleared the same way.

Ask for the payoff and the tax balance before you list, so you know what is left for you. In a compact city with steady demand, many owners find they have more room to choose than they expected.

• The deed, or trust papers if the house is held in a trust.
  • The current tax bill and proof of payment.
  • A payoff letter from any lender with a lien.
  • A plat or survey if a fence or lot line might be questioned.
  • Receipts for foundation, roof or drainage work.

Buyers in a compact city compare houses closely. A seller with a tidy folder and a short, honest condition list looks careful, and that tends to bring cleaner offers.

sections.h2: What happens between offer and closing
sections.html:
After you accept an offer, the title search begins. The examiner reads the record for liens, unpaid tax and ownership gaps, and a lender with an open mortgage supplies a payoff figure. If problems come up, they are cleared from your proceeds where possible.

On the closing day you sign the deed and the settlement statement, the payoff is sent, and the deed is filed with the Jefferson County Probate Court. The settlement statement lists the price, the payoff, the tax split and what you receive, so read it before you sign.

Homewood has few houses for sale at any time, so a buyer who sees clean paperwork and a clear condition list tends to move faster. If a closing is delayed, call the title office and ask what is missing and when it can be supplied, so one small gap does not push the date back. Ask for a copy of the plat if the lot lines are in question, and gather any receipts for foundation or drainage work.

Owners here can list, sell on their own or accept cash. A well-kept house suits a listing, while one with problems is harder to place at retail.

  • List if the house shows well and you can wait for a buyer with a loan.
  • Sell privately to skip the commission, if you can manage the details.
  • Take cash if you need to close on your schedule, or the house needs repairs, has a tenant issue or belongs to an estate.

Cash Home Buyers quotes Homewood houses as they are, and the decision stays with you.

sections.h2: What to bring to the closing
sections.html: Take a photo ID, the deed or trust papers, a payoff letter from any lender, and all keys and garage openers. If the office needs more, it will say so ahead of time.

faqs.q: Can I sell my Homewood house if it needs repairs?
faqs.a: Yes. A cash buyer accepts the house as it is and prices in the work, while loan-financed buyers may ask for repairs after inspection.

faqs.q: Where do I record a deed for a Homewood sale?
faqs.a: At the Jefferson County Probate Court, in either the Birmingham Division or the Bessemer Division. Clerks cannot draft the deed.

faqs.q: When are Alabama property taxes due?
faqs.a: Due October 1, delinquent after December 31. Closing usually splits the year's bill.

faqs.q: Does the Hollywood Historic District change how I sell?
faqs.a: It can change who is interested, since the district joined the National Register in 2002. Ask city hall about rules for your address.

faqs.q: What if I am selling a Homewood rental?
faqs.a: Yes, with or without tenants. Read the lease for notice terms and ask a lawyer about the tenant's rights first.
